tweets.html: The Astros lost 3-2. They are 63-62.Hunter Brown had a grind of a five-inning outing. Cal Raleigh hit a Crawford Box special that proved to be the difference. Houston loses two of three to Seattle, but maintains a two-game AL West lead.
